orientation: bow to the left (foremast raked forward, gun and grapnel at the bow end), stern to the right (rudder, raised stern)
scale: no scale bar on the drawing; only ratios are used. Design length 14.0 m over stem head to stern top (3140 px) => 0.1 m cell = 22.4 px
